title: Graduate Engineering Program - expression of interest (Central Victoria)
location: Central Victoria (Bendigo office); also Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Northern NSW
content_text: Westera Partners careers page. Westera is a consulting engineering firm in Civil, Structural and Environmental Engineering with offices in Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Northern NSW and Central Victoria. Current listed roles include Senior Civil Design Engineer (Sippy Downs) and Structural Drafter (Brisbane, 3-5 years), not junior. Graduate Program: Whether you have graduated from university, or you are looking for work experience as an undergraduate, we are looking for candidates with motivation and passion to join our industry. Our 4-year Graduate Engineering Program produces confident mid-level engineers with an opportunity to achieve their professional accreditation status. If you would like to apply for a graduate position, or even explore work experience or paid work opportunities as an undergraduate engineer, please email your resume, academic transcript, application letter (including your preferred office and discipline of engineering) and resume to HR@westerapartners.com.au. Central Victoria phone +61 3 5441 0922.
apply_instructions: Email resume, academic transcript and application letter (preferred office and discipline) to HR@westerapartners.com.au.
